query: Получай курсы валют с https://api.exchangerate.host/latest и сохраняй результат в файл /data/output/rates.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: exchange_rates_flow
  name: Exchange Rates Fetch and Save
  description: Fetch latest exchange rates from exchangerate.host API and save to
    JSON file
triggers:
- id: trigger_main
  type: manual
  condition: ''
sources:
- id: source_exchange_api
  name: Exchange Rate API
  type: HTTP
  location: https://api.exchangerate.host/latest
processing_elements: []
sinks:
- id: sink_file
  name: Save to JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/rates.json
processed_data:
- id: rates_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_exchange_api
  to_id: sink_file
  data_ref: rates_json

error.details:
Trigger(s) ['trigger_main'] have type 'manual'.
The flow will NOT start automatically in NiFi — someone must press Run in the NiFi UI.
Change trigger type to 'schedule' or 'event' for production use.
